scope: Follow-up coverage for LAFAN40 / G1 29DoF, limited to the three checkpoint releases below.
selection: Only these three releases remain under inspection. Projects without a public checkpoint or with only single-motion checkpoints are no longer being followed.

entries.name: Humanoid-GPT Transformer 216
entries.gap: The original 16 × 136 Transformer checkpoint passed 160 matched-input comparisons, 4 resets and 32 endpoint cases on macOS and Linux. Its first complete 40-motion rollout has finished; independent trajectory verification and a second run are required before publication.
entries.next_step: Complete trajectory verification, repeatability, clean-clone reproduction and public evidence alignment before ranking.

entries.name: ScaleBFM
entries.gap: The official raw M checkpoint passed 160 matched-input comparisons and 4 resets exactly on macOS and Linux using author float32 reference kinematics, whole-body mode 7 and reference forcing. Full 40-motion evaluation and repeatability are in progress; TensorRT/CUDA numeric equivalence is not implied.
entries.next_step: Complete trajectory verification, repeatability, clean-clone reproduction and public evidence alignment before ranking.

entries.name: HoloMotion v1.3.1
entries.gap: The current author runtime legacy RoPE handling passed 160 matched-input comparisons and 4 resets on macOS and Linux. The fixed v1.3.1 checkpoint is undergoing complete 40-motion rollout and repeatability checks.
entries.next_step: Complete trajectory verification, repeatability, clean-clone reproduction and public evidence alignment before ranking.
